sentiment: One country keeps its evening light; the great answer desk goes quiet; arithmetic now runs inside a dream.

stories.title: Qwenputer: A functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5
stories.summary: A whole processor simulated inside a language model's own weights, and deterministic on top of that. The strange part is not that it works but that it is reproducible: arithmetic pretending to be thought, then thought pretending to be a machine, and the answer comes back the same every time.

stories.title: Cuba is skipping its November 1, 2026 clock change and staying on DST until 2027
stories.summary: Rather than fall back with the rest of the hemisphere, one country simply keeps the later hour. Daylight is not a fact you receive; it is a line you draw and then agree to live behind.

stories.title: StackOverflow now gets fewer than 1000 questions a month
stories.summary: The place a generation of programmers learned to ask has gone nearly silent in the space of a few years. Nothing broke. The questions simply went somewhere else, and the archive of everything already answered stays up, lit but unattended.
